Name: Rodney for NPC Adventures (Deprecated)
Author: TheFrenchDodo
Description:
[center][img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/699981232758325312/1072665101557059614/Intro.png[/img]
[b](This mod is an add-on for ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13437]Creatives Differences - Rodney NPC[/url]﻿)[/b][/center]
You like two-time award winner, author Rodney O'Brien, so much, and you want him to follow you everywhere? Well now you can, thanks to this pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4582]NPC Adventures[/url]!

[b]Rodney [/b]is a fighter companion. His mere presence will grant you grandiose benefits! (+2 luck, +2 defense, +2 speed, +2 attack and +50 max energy). Take him around town, he'll be happy to help, and he will always have something to say.



[size=5]How to install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4582]Install NPC Adventures[/url]. (minimum version 1.0.2 Polycule)

[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13437]Install Creatives Differences - Rodney NPC[/url]﻿

[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
